subject: Specifying the condition probability density function pi(x | y) and then samples from that via MCMC

messages.author: aa5a92076f4ff4be
messages.subject: Specifying the condition probability density function pi(x | y) and then samples from that via MCMC
parts:
Hi all,

I coded the Modified Metropolis algorithm for sampling from pi(x | y) in both Matlab and R and it works well.
But, Conceptually i have a problem applying that in Stan, in which block "model"  or "generated quantities"? and how can i implement that?

The following is the Matlab code which I want to transfer it into Stan:

%-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 % Modified Metropolis algorithm for sampling from pi(x | F_L)
 for j=1:nc
 for m=1:ns
 % Step 1:
 for k=1:d
 a=z(k,j,m)+randn; % Step 1(a)
 r=min(1,normpdf(a)/normpdf(z(k,j,m))); % Step 1(b)
 % Step 1(c):
 if rand<r
 q(k)=a;
 else
 q(k)=z(k,j,m);
 end
 end
 % Step 2: applying the conditional part
 if sum(q)>Y(L) % q belongs to F_L
 z(:,j,m+1)=q;
 else
 z(:,j,m+1)=z(:,j,m);
 end
 end
 end
%-------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thank you very much in advance for your help.
Hamed

messages.author: f769d7d2cfcf4edc
messages.subject: Re: Specifying the condition probability density function pi(x | y) and then samples from that via MCMC
parts: I don't really speak matlab, but could you just give what you're trying to do? You're giving an algorithm, but stan implements the algorithm for you. For stan, you only need to specify the posterior probability distribution (a log joint posterior probability distribution). So what are you wanting to sample from? What is the prior? What is the likelihood? What are the parameters of interest?
